claim_ceiling: Starter hazard inventory and candidate verification controls only. No risk acceptability, medical-device compliance, or safety-control effectiveness claim.

intended_initial_use: simulation-only sealed mock supply tote transfer
passive tray docking on mock fixtures

common_control_contract: Symthaea has no direct actuator authority and cannot approve its own generated design.
A deterministic capability gateway checks task, tool, revisions, permissions and evidence.
An independent safety controller must implement any eventual physical safety functions; this document does not establish their adequacy.
Unknown or malformed evidence fails closed and is not normalized into a valid default.
Every hazard-control claim must bind to a requirement, exact design revision, test artifact, result and independent reviewer.

hazards.hazard: Unintended robot motion or loss of balance / fall
potential_harm: collision or impact with nearby people or objects
robot unable to reach a defined safe state
candidate_controls: watchdog and stop paths outside the cognitive planner
fall-state sensing and a hazard-reviewed protective response
verification_cases: unexpected contact in a surrogate fixture

hazards.hazard: Pinch, crush, or entrapment around joints, end effectors, drawers or fixtures
initiating_conditions: person or object enters pinch zone
geometry or fixture differs from the model
candidate_controls: guarding or physical separation where required
unresolved: applicable collaborative-robot standards for the chosen task

hazards.hazard: Tool detachment, incorrect attachment, or wrong end-effector identity
candidate_controls: tool revision and payload binding in every plan
separate stop path and safe-release definition
verification_cases: tool revision changes between plan and acceptance

hazards.hazard: Load slip, drop, or instability during sealed mock-tote handling
initiating_conditions: incorrect mass or centre of mass
potential_harm: collision with a person or fixture
candidate_controls: force limits backed by measured fixture data

hazards.hazard: Stale world model, calibration, permissions, or plan remains usable after context changes
verification_cases: each revision dimension changes after validation
plan ID reused with different digest
unresolved: canonical production plan bytes and signature

initiating_conditions: occlusion, glare, low light, damaged label
candidate_controls: verify label against tote/object identity and task context
verification_cases: low confidence must not be normalized into a valid ID

hazards.hazard: Loss of communications, time synchronization, or remote supervision
potential_harm: failure to recover or report state
candidate_controls: reconnect requires fresh state and authorization
verification_cases: network loss at each task phase

hazards.hazard: Low energy reserve or power fault prevents controlled recovery
candidate_controls: power-loss response independent of mission planner
verification_cases: power failure during representative simulated poses

initiating_conditions: tool marked clean without validated evidence
potential_harm: contamination transfer in a healthcare environment
candidate_controls: cleaning_status remains not_assessed until evidence is reviewed
cleanability review as a separate gate
verification_cases: manifest that claims cleaning without evidence

hazards.hazard: Unintended capture or disclosure of personal/clinical information
initiating_conditions: inventory task drifts to patient observation
potential_harm: loss of trust or regulatory exposure
candidate_controls: initial task scope limited to synthetic labels and non-patient fixtures
local data minimization and explicit retention policy
task allowlist and output schema block patient data
verification_cases: task request changes to patient observation

hazards.hazard: Cyber compromise or prompt/task injection changes tool, task, or safety policy
candidate_controls: independent safety controller unreachable by planner commands

hazards.hazard: Tool or task silently crosses from nonclinical logistics into clinical function
initiating_conditions: future version enables diagnosis or medication delivery
candidate_controls: new clinical functions require a separate program and evidence gate
verification_cases: attempt to enable physical actuation through unrecognized field
unresolved: clinical and regulatory governance for any scope expansion

required_next_steps: Define intended use and operating environment before assigning severity/likelihood or risk acceptability.
Map each hazard to a versioned risk-control requirement, verification method and residual-risk review owner.
Have qualified robotics, functional-safety, medical-device and target-jurisdiction specialists independently review applicability and controls.
Keep simulated contract outcomes separate from bench measurements, HIL results, controlled field observations and clinical evidence.
